evidence.quote: We use BioLinkBERT (Yasunaga et al., 2022) as the backbone LLM since it is specifically trained on the biomedical corpuses.

decisions.rationale: R3: BioLinkBERT is the pretrained backbone LLM.

evidence.quote: We use learnable d dimensional embeddings to represent each class, f cls ( c ) = h c .

decisions.rationale: R3: an embedding representation uses table lookup with a trainable embedding matrix.

decisions.chain_element: concatenation of measures of source modality X source and target modality X target

evidence.quote: let X = [ X source , X target ] be the concatenation of measures of source modality X source ∈ R n,m s and target modality X target ∈ R n,m t

decisions.rationale: R6: the source explicitly states concatenation and its source-then-target order.

decisions.chain_element: estimate expression levels of target modality from the input modality

evidence.quote: Modality prediction aims to estimate expression levels of target modality from the input modality.

decisions.rationale: R1: this element states the downstream task performed by the model.

evidence.quote: a graph neural network (GNN) on a gene similarity graph G

decisions.rationale: R0: the element names the graph data object without applying a transformation.

evidence.quote: The gene perturbation embeddings are then computed using simple graph convolution (SGC) (Wu et al., 2019)

decisions.rationale: R7: graph convolution/message passing is stated, and no catalog operation represents it.

evidence.quote: We use a linear mapping W ∈ R m × d to project the noised gene expression x t ∈ R m into R d

decisions.rationale: R3: the named linear mapping is a learned projection.

evidence.quote: and further mix it with the sinusoidal time embedding (Appendix B.1) to inject diffusion time step information

decisions.rationale: R3: sinusoidal time embeddings are positional/time encodings inside the model.

decisions.chain_element: use annotated scRNA-seq data as a reference

evidence.quote: This task typically requires some external reference, in most cases using annotated scRNA-seq data as a reference

decisions.rationale: R1: this element identifies an external reference data source.

decisions.chain_element: estimate the proportions of different cell types

evidence.quote: Cell type deconvolution is to estimate the proportions of different cell types within mixed-cell spatial transcriptomics data.

decisions.rationale: R1: this element states the downstream estimation task.

evidence.quote: mix in an additional learnable batch embedding with the latent embedding according to the batch label of the input cell

decisions.rationale: R3: a learnable batch embedding is represented through lookup in a trainable embedding matrix.

evidence.quote: We process the context condition similarly as the input embedding using a linear projection, but without the time embedding

decisions.rationale: R3: the named linear projection maps the masked-expression context into a feature space.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no graph-convolution or graph-message-passing primitive; projection, addition, and attention do not represent neighborhood aggregation over a gene similarity graph.
